description: Configure node taints and tolerations on an EKS cluster to isolate GPU and spot-instance workloads. Must: identify GPU nodes and spot nodes, apply taints (nvidia.com/gpu=true:NoSchedule for GPU, spot=true:NoSchedule for spot), update workload manifests with correct tolerations and node selectors, verify that non-GPU workloads are evicted from GPU nodes, verify spot workloads only schedule on spot nodes, and monitor for scheduling failures. Risk factors: existing workloads without tolerations get evicted, GPU node under-utilization if tolerations are too narrow, spot node churn causing workload disruption. Tools available: kubectl, Helm, aws CLI, Prometheus.
